steps.message: Create a playlist in Retro Music titled "Party Mix 553" with the following songs, in order: Endless Summer, Moonlight Sonata, Voices in the Hall. Then export the playlist to the Downloads directory on the device.

Execute: adb shell "date; getprop persist.sys.timezone; pm list packages | grep -i -E 'retro|music'; echo '---SONGS---'; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/media --projection _id:title:_data --where \"title in ('Endless Summer','Moonlight Sonata','Voices in the Hall')\"; echo '---PLAYLISTS---'; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --projection _id:name --where \"name='Party Mix 553'\"; echo '---M3U---'; find /sdcard/Download /sdcard/Music -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname '*.m3u' -o -iname '*.m3u8' \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 20"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date; getprop persist.sys.timezone; pm list packages | grep -i -E 'retro|music'; echo '---SONGS---'; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/media --projection _id:title:_data --where \"title in ('Endless Summer','Moonlight Sonata','Voices in the Hall')\"; echo '---PLAYLISTS---'; content query --uri content://media/external/audio/playlists --projection _id:name --where \"name='Party Mix 553'\"; echo '---M3U---'; find /sdcard/Download /sdcard/Music -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname '*.m3u' -o -iname '*.m3u8' \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 20""
